summary: Notification preferences by category and channel.
whenToUse: Allowing independent choices for email, push and other channels.
whenNotToUse: To display received notifications, use NotificationCenter.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange
props.description: Map from channel id to active category ids.

accessibility: The table associates headers with controls that have accessible names.
responsive: The table scrolls within its container.
